gloss: which time (in a series); what number time

definitions.explanation: Asks for the ordinal position of an occasion — whether something is the second, third, fifth time, and so on. English has no single word for it, so it is usually translated with a full question.

examples.japanese: {今回|こんかい}で{何回目|なんかいめ}ですか。
examples.english: How many times is this now?

examples.japanese: {日本|にほん}に{来|く}るのは{何回目|なんかいめ}ですか。
examples.english: Is this your first time in Japan, or have you been before?

examples.japanese: {同|おな}じ{失敗|しっぱい}を{繰|く}り{返|かえ}すのは、これで{何回目|なんかいめ}だろう。
examples.english: I wonder how many times this makes that I have repeated the same mistake.

notes:
Formed from {何回|なんかい} (how many times) plus the ordinal suffix 〜{目|め}. The 〜{目|め} is what makes it ordinal: {何回|なんかい} asks for a total count, {何回目|なんかいめ} asks for a position in a series.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {何回目|なんかいめ}ですか: which time is this?
- これで{何回目|なんかいめ}: how many times does this make
- {何回目|なんかいめ}の{挑戦|ちょうせん}: which attempt (in a series)

ANSWERING:
Answers use the same 〜{目|め} pattern: {一回目|いっかいめ} (the first time), {二回目|にかいめ} (the second time), {三回目|さんかいめ} (the third time).
